input_path.description: Input data path (CSV/JSON/Parquet) containing OHLC columns (volume optional).

output_path.description: Output path (optional). Defaults to input folder with _indicators suffix. Supports CSV/JSON/Parquet.

indicators.description: List of indicators to compute. If omitted or null, compute all 151 supported ones (e.g., SMA, EMA, MACD, RSI, BBANDS, ATR, ADX, STOCH, AROON, CCI, MOM, ROC, SAR...).

config.description: Custom indicator params (optional), e.g., periods, thresholds.

validate.description: Whether to generate validation JSON with stats, new columns, and preview.

outputSchema.description: Data file with added indicators plus optional validation JSON.

name: sentiment_analysis_bert
description: Local BERT/FinBERT sentiment analysis (default local finbert-tone). Outputs positive/negative/neutral with confidence.

input_path.description: Input file path (CSV/JSON/TXT). CSV/JSON must contain a text column; TXT is one text per line.

input_token.description: Single text input (use when not providing input_path).

output_path.description: Output path (optional). Defaults to input folder with _sentiment suffix. Supports CSV/JSON.

text_column.description: Text column name (optional, auto-detect). Common: text/content/news/title/description.

batch_size.description: Batch size (tune by GPU/CPU). Suggested CPU=4, GPU=16-32.

device.description: Device: auto (detect GPU), cpu, cuda (force GPU).

output_format.description: Output format. auto: infer by file extension.

output_path.description: Output path.

name: backtest
description: Backtest tool. Evaluate strategy or model predictions on historical data; computes return, Sharpe, max drawdown, etc.

outputSchema.description: Backtest results with return, Sharpe, and other metrics.

name: calculate_ic
description: Compute IC (Information Coefficient) metrics for factors. Returns IC mean/std, IR, Rank IC mean/std, Rank IR, IC win rate, etc., to assess predictive power and stability.

formula.description: Qlib factor expression, e.g., 'Ts_Mean($close, 10) / Ts_Mean($close, 30) - 1'. Supports time-series ops (Ts_Mean/Ts_Std) and cross-sectional ops.

label_expr.description: Label expression for future return; default T+1 to T+2 return.

provider_uri.description: Qlib data path; auto-detects qlib_bin under project if not set.

ic_mean.description: IC mean – Pearson corr mean between factor and future return.

ic_std.description: IC std – dispersion of IC series.

ir.description: Information Ratio (IR) = IC mean / IC std.

rank_ic_mean.description: Rank IC mean – Spearman rank IC mean (robust to outliers).

rank_ic_std.description: Rank IC std – std of rank IC series.

rank_ir.description: Rank IR = Rank IC mean / Rank IC std.

ic_win_rate.description: IC win rate – fraction of days with IC>0 (directional consistency).

details.description: Details such as parsed expression, stock count, record count, etc.

name: train_qcm
description: AlphaQCM training tool. Quantile-based distributional RL for Alpha mining. Supports QRDQN, IQN, FQF architectures; learns and optimizes Alpha factors via RL. Runs asynchronously with task/log queries.

model.description: Model type. qrdqn: Quantile Regression DQN; iqn: Implicit Quantile Networks; fqf: Fully Quantile Function.

pool.description: Alpha pool capacity (number of factors maintained). Suggested: 10/20/50/100.

std_lam.description: Std lambda parameter controlling distribution shape. Suggested: 0.5/1.0/2.0.

task_name.description: Task name for identifying the training job.

outputSchema.description: Training launch info. Runs asynchronously; task/logs can be queried.

name: train_AFF

config_file.description: Config file path (optional). If provided, overrides with file params; else use config_params.

config_params.description: Optional training parameter dict: instruments, train_end_year, seeds, save_name, zoo_size, etc.

task_name.description: Task name for the training job.

outputSchema.description: Training launch info. Runs asynchronously; task/logs can be queried.

config_file.description: Config file path (optional). If provided, use its params; else use config_params.

task_name.description: Task name for the training job.

outputSchema.description: Training launch info. Runs asynchronously; task/logs can be queried.

name: train_GP_AlphaSAGE

config_file.description: Config file path (optional). If provided, use its params; else use config_params.

task_name.description: Task name for the training job.

outputSchema.description: Training launch info. Runs asynchronously; task/logs can be queried.

name: train_PPO_AlphaSAGE

config_file.description: Config file path (optional). If provided, use its params; else use config_params.

task_name.description: Task name for the training job.

outputSchema.description: Training launch info. Runs asynchronously; task/logs can be queried.

name: train_task_status

name: report_generate
description: Generate professional PDF reports by combining LLM analysis with data visualizations.

llm_json.description: Required. LLM output JSON report data (dict). Should contain fields like: title, symbol, analysis/content/text, summary (dict), chart_titles (dict mapping chart index to title), sections (list of dicts with title and content).

output_path.description: Required. PDF output file path. If relative, will be based on report_dir. Automatically appends .pdf extension if missing.

data_files.description: Optional. List of data file paths (CSV/JSON) for generating charts. Files should contain OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) data with date column.

chart_config.description: Optional. Chart configuration dictionary. Supports: type (candle/line/ohlc/renko/pnf), style (yahoo/binance/charles/etc.), volume (boolean), figsize (tuple), savefig (dict with dpi, bbox_inches, facecolor).

template_path.description: Optional. Custom HTML template file path. If not provided, uses default English template.

report_dir.description: Optional. Report output directory (default: ./data/Result/report). Charts will be saved in {report_dir}/charts/ subdirectory.

outputSchema.description: Report generation result with PDF file path
